subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining rapid-media batching behavior be accepted as a LINE-owned opt-in config surface, designed as a broader shared channel/plugin contract, or intentionally left unsupported for channels without native grouping metadata?
rationale: LINE has no native grouping metadata and the request adds delayed webhook handling plus a new configuration surface, so automation should not choose the product boundary, defaults, or heuristic semantics on its own.

options.title: Plugin-owned LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a default-off LINE media batching option that buffers only same account, conversation, and sender downloadable media, with docs covering latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Shared media batching contract
options.body: Design a channel SDK or gateway contract for media-aware aggregation before adding LINE behavior, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep heuristic batching unsupported
options.body: Keep native Telegram media-group handling only and document that channels without reliable grouping metadata may dispatch separate media turns.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a default-off LINE media batching option that buffers only same account, conversation, and sender downloadable media, with docs covering latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses config policy, shared debounce semantics, and channel plugin boundaries where recent history shows direct involvement.
